description: This file defines a custom PEP8 style checker class for Kivy projects, including configuration for ignored style violations and a command-line interface for checking Python files or directories recursively.

classes.name: KivyStyleChecker
classes.description: A subclass of pep8.Checker that ignores specific style violations for Kivy projects.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the KivyStyleChecker with a filename and ignores specific PEP8 violations.

methods.name: report_error
methods.description: Overrides the report_error method to customize error reporting.
